description: This file defines a TableMap class and related functions for managing and caching table structure data, including cell positions, dimensions, and problem detection, used in a ProseMirror-based editor.

classes.name: TableMap
classes.description: Represents the structure of a table, including dimensions, cell positions, and problems, with methods to find cell dimensions, navigate cells, and compute cell rectangles.

methods.name: findCell
methods.description: Finds the dimensions of the cell at a given position.

methods.name: colCount
methods.description: Returns the column index of the cell at a given position.

methods.name: nextCell
methods.description: Finds the next cell in a specified direction along horizontal or vertical axis.

methods.name: rectBetween
methods.description: Returns the rectangle spanning two specified cells.

methods.name: cellsInRect
methods.description: Returns positions of cells with top-left corners within a given rectangle.

methods.name: positionAt
methods.description: Returns the start position of the cell at specified row and column.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a cached TableMap for a table node.
